assumptions: Decisions at 10 Hz: one torque pair is held for five 50 Hz body steps, so one decision changes a joint velocity by at most 0.1 rad/s. The plan's 50 Hz decisions leave a torque's effect on the next displacement two orders below the coasting displacement.

The sensors report the measured displacement, velocity change and angle change over the last decision; the world head predicts the next decision's values of the same three sensors, so imagined trajectories compose from predicted deltas without any supplied kinematics.
Displacement sensor bounds are +-0.12 arm lengths per decision (typical values 0.03); the plan's wider bounds compressed the sensory code and tripled the prediction error.

The world head is a records cortex (Marr 1969, Albus 1971): the reading of the sensory, goal, action and recall neurons, a fixed random expansion regenerated from the seed, the 160 most active of 32,000 cells kept (lateral inhibition), delta-rule records per prediction field at rate 0.1. No replay ring (replay per transition 0): a reading touches few records and the outcome is written into exactly those. The MLP baseline runs twice, under the same replay policy (none) and with its own ring of 4,096 transitions, so the comparison is read both ways; without a ring every dense online learner tried (the MLP with Adam, the settled recurrent head with momentum) diverges or stalls on this autocorrelated stream.

Copier tracking is scored after a 50-decision approach from a random start; the bar is the plan's 0.10 or 1.2 times the supplied Jacobian-PD controller's own tracking error on the same paths, whichever is larger, because that controller calibrates the difficulty. The planner is supplied search: every torque pair is imagined through the learned model in one batched settle; a candidate is scored by how well its predicted hand displacement tracks a clipped velocity field toward the target. Distance reduction of the next state alone cannot see a torque's effect (second order in the decision interval).

Two isolated evaluation copies per checkpoint (the plan's evaluation creates isolated checkpoint copies and never modifies the saved parent life): a read-only copy reports initial competence; a copy that keeps learning with exploration off, one held-out target after another, is the gated measure, because the world head keeps repairing itself in the agent's one operating mode. Lesions are compared on the first fifty held-out targets of adapting copies, before relearning can mask them.
